Report this job Software Engineer – Platform as a Service (PaaS) Meet the Team You will join the Platform as a Service (PaaS) team, the backbone of our digital infrastructure. We manage a diverse ecosystem of platforms, including API Gateways like Mule and Mashery, messaging systems like Kafka, and other middleware systems. As a senior member of this team, you will lead the evolution of our internal platforms, driving the transition toward No-Ops and AIOps to ensure our infrastructure is as intelligent as it is scalable. Your Impact You will take ownership of the full-stack lifecycle of our platform offerings. From designing intuitive UI/UX interfaces for platform consumers to architecting the backend services that power our initiatives, your work will directly impact client productivity and system reliability. You will lead technical direction, mentor junior engineers, and champion architectural standards that allow us to scale seamlessly. Platform Architecture: Design and maintain scalable PaaS solutions, including API Gateways (Mashery, Mule) and Kafka messaging clusters. Full Stack Development: Build and maintain platform portals and dashboards using UI/UX technologies (Angular, React, Figma) and robust backend services (Python, Go). Operational Excellence: Manage CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Argo CD, and Argo Workflows to ensure seamless delivery and deployment. AI/ML & AIOps: Drive the migration toward AIOps and No-Ops by integrating ML models to automate monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure optimization. System Design & Ownership: Lead complex system design sessions, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across all platform layers. Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a technical lead, conducting code reviews, establishing best practices, and mentoring junior engineers to foster a culture of technical excellence. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between infrastructure, SRE, and software engineering teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions. On-Call Support: Provide proactive on-call support for platform services, ensuring high availability and rapid resolution of operational issues to maintain service level objectives. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record in full-stack development and platform engineering, including 1+ years in machine learning-related roles. Expertise in building modern, user-centric interfaces using React or Angular, supported by Figma design workflows. Deep proficiency in Python and/or Go for backend service development. Experience managing and optimizing Postgres and MongoDB databases. Advanced skills in CI/CD automation with Jenkins, Argo CD, and Argo Workflows, with a good understanding of Kubernetes-based deployment solutions. Preferred Qualifications Good experience with Kubernetes and good understanding of API Gateways (e.g., Mashery, Mule) and messaging platforms (Kafka). Experience with building AI products and workflows, including LLMs, LangChain, RAG systems, and agentic frameworks. Demonstrated experience in AI/ML for automating day-to-day operational workloads. Ability to architect distributed systems that are resilient, observable, and easy to maintain. Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Report this job The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build reliable, intuitive, and scalable full-stack products for Member Records, the care-team-member-facing context layer within CareHub. Member Records surfaces the right member information at the right moment so each care-team interaction is informed and actionable, reducing the need to search across fragmented systems. The experience brings together the context care-team members need to support a member, including member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indication, and history. Current product work also includes helping care-team members understand device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions, especially when a member is active in more than one program. Member Records is part of the broader Member Record & Configurator pod. The adjacent Configurator experience gives physical therapists a way to review and personalize exercise therapy programs, while Member Records provides the member context needed to make those decisions. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to turn complex workflows into simple experiences. You will contribute from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys owning meaningful product areas end to end, makes sound technical trade-offs, and raises the quality of the systems and team around them. What You'll Accomplish Design and deliver full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Build maintainable frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, and data models for member-record workflows. Translate ambiguous product and workflow requirements into clear technical designs and incremental delivery plans. Collaborate with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and partner engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, performance, security, observability, and maintainability of production systems. Write high-quality, well-tested code and contribute to effective testing strategies across the stack. Participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, incident response, and operational improvements. Identify technical debt and make pragmatic improvements that help the team move faster safely. Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, thoughtful reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Use modern developer and AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development quality and productivity. Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru). Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).
